This alignment suggests a strategic timing to capitalize on the heightened attention around Musk's projects and the growing interest in AI technologies. The coordinated IPO timelines reflect the competitive and fast-evolving landscape of artificial intelligence and space exploration industries. By aligning their market entries, OpenAI and Anthropic aim to maximize investor interest and market impact during a period marked by significant technological advancements and high-profile launches.

items.title: OpenAI and Molecule.one use GPT-5.4-powered AI chemist to improve Chan-Lam coupling yields for primary sulfonamides in medicinal chemistry experiments [ ~ ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI and Molecule.one collaborated to develop a near-autonomous AI chemist powered by GPT-5.4 that significantly improved the Chan-Lam coupling reaction for primary sulfonamides, a key process in medicinal chemistry. The AI system, integrated with Molecule.one's high-throughput laboratory, autonomously designed and conducted experiments, identifying additives that boosted reaction yields for the majority of tested substrates. This advancement addresses a longstanding challenge in drug discovery, where low yields in synthesizing certain molecules limit exploration and development. By enhancing the reliability and efficiency of this reaction, the AI-driven approach offers medicinal chemists a more practical method to produce important compounds, potentially accelerating the creation of new therapeutics across various medical fields.

items.title: OpenAI launches LifeSciBench, an expert-authored benchmark with 750 tasks to evaluate AI systems on real-world life science research workflows and decisions [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has launched LifeSciBench, a comprehensive benchmark designed to evaluate AI systems on their ability to perform complex, real-world life science research tasks. Developed and reviewed by Ph.D.-level scientists with industry experience, LifeSciBench includes 750 expert-authored tasks across seven workflows and biological domains, reflecting the multifaceted nature of scientific research beyond simple fact recall. The benchmark assesses AI performance on tasks such as interpreting evidence, designing experiments, and making research decisions under uncertainty, using detailed rubrics with over 19,000 criteria to evaluate scientific accuracy and reasoning. LifeSciBench incorporates diverse data artifacts and emphasizes multi-step reasoning, aiming to measure how well AI can support practical life science workflows and contribute meaningfully to drug discovery and related fields.

items.title: UK government partners with Google DeepMind to develop AI prototype for faster housing planning decisions [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: The UK government has partnered with Google DeepMind to develop an AI-powered prototype designed to accelerate housing planning decisions. This collaboration aims to streamline the planning process and support faster development of new homes across the country. The initiative leverages advanced artificial intelligence to analyze planning applications more efficiently, potentially reducing delays and improving decision-making in the housing sector. This partnership reflects a broader effort to integrate AI technologies into public sector services to address housing challenges.

items.title: Google DeepMind outlines AI Control Roadmap combining traditional safeguards and real-time monitoring to secure internal AI agents against misalignment and threats [ * ] [ ⬢ ]
items.content_text: Google DeepMind has introduced an AI Control Roadmap designed to secure internal AI agents by combining traditional cybersecurity measures with real-time monitoring and model alignment techniques. This framework treats AI agents as potentially misaligned, implementing a layered defense system that includes threat modeling, continuous supervision by trusted AI systems, and incremental permission granting based on verified behavior. The roadmap builds on established cybersecurity practices and adapts them to the unique challenges posed by advanced AI, such as the potential for agents to evade detection or cause harm. It emphasizes scalable security protocols that adjust according to the AI's capabilities, ensuring both asynchronous and real-time responses to mitigate risks effectively. This approach aims to provide robust safeguards as AI systems become more capable and integrated into critical tasks.

items.title: OpenAI launches Deployment Simulation to predict AI model behavior and safety risks before release using real conversation data [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has introduced Deployment Simulation, a new method that predicts how AI models will behave before they are released by replaying real conversation data with candidate models. This approach helps identify potential safety risks and undesired behaviors in realistic contexts, improving the accuracy of pre-deployment evaluations. Deployment Simulation addresses limitations of traditional testing by using recent deployment conversations to simulate model responses, reducing biases and increasing coverage of possible behaviors. It has been applied successfully to GPT-5-series models and complex agentic rollouts, providing valuable insights that inform safety measures and deployment decisions. OpenAI plans to expand the use of this method to enhance future model development and risk assessment processes.

items.title: OpenAI launches Partner Network with $150M investment to accelerate global enterprise AI adoption and train 300,000 certified consultants by end of 2026 [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has launched the Partner Network, a new program designed to accelerate enterprise AI adoption worldwide by collaborating with trusted partners who have deep industry expertise and global delivery capabilities. The company is investing $150 million to support this initiative and aims to train 300,000 certified consultants by the end of 2026 to help organizations effectively integrate AI into their operations. The Partner Network enables partners to build, sell, and deploy AI solutions using OpenAI's technology, offering a tiered system that recognizes partners' sales performance, technical skills, and deployment experience. This program also includes specializations in key areas like cybersecurity and coding, and a pilot Forward Deployed Experts program to provide enhanced support for complex enterprise deployments. By fostering a robust ecosystem of partners, OpenAI seeks to help enterprises move from AI ambition to measurable outcomes through strategic use case identification, workflow redesign, secure integration, and change management. Early collaborations with companies such as Agilent, eBay, Paychex, and T-Mobile demonstrate the network's potential to drive significant improvements in customer service, operational efficiency, and AI-enabled experiences.

items.title: OpenAI launches three new Academy courses to teach practical AI skills, workflows, and agent use for workplace applications [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has launched three new courses on its Academy platform designed to help individuals and organizations develop practical AI skills and integrate AI tools into their daily work. The courses-AI Foundations, Applied AI Foundations, and Agents and Workflows-guide learners from understanding basic AI concepts to creating repeatable workflows and managing agent-assisted tasks. These courses are developed in collaboration with partners like BCG, Accenture, and BBVA, and focus on hands-on learning tailored to real work scenarios. They aim to build AI fluency across teams, enabling users to improve routine tasks, design structured workflows, and apply AI responsibly and effectively in the workplace. OpenAI Academy also offers certificates upon course completion to recognize progress and encourage knowledge sharing within organizations. The initiative supports enterprises in scaling AI adoption by providing a consistent, evolving curriculum aligned with OpenAI's latest technologies and safety practices.

items.title: Preply launches OpenAI-powered Lesson Insights to generate AI-driven personalized feedback and exercises for language learners [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: Preply, the world's largest online language learning marketplace, has launched Lesson Insights, an AI-powered feature using OpenAI technology to generate personalized lesson summaries, feedback, and exercises for language learners. This tool analyzes lesson transcripts to provide tailored guidance on grammar, vocabulary, and pronunciation, enhancing the learning experience while reducing tutors' administrative workload. Lesson Insights integrates seamlessly into Preply's platform, delivering detailed reports to both tutors and students shortly after each session. These insights support continuous learning by informing personalized homework and practice, helping learners track progress and stay motivated. Preply's adoption of OpenAI extends beyond this feature, with AI tools embedded across the company to improve operations and content creation.

items.title: OpenAI plans to acquire Ona to integrate secure, persistent cloud environments into Codex for long-running AI agents in enterprise workflows [ * ] [ ⬢ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI announced plans to acquire Ona to enhance its Codex platform by integrating secure, persistent cloud environments that support long-running AI agents in enterprise workflows. This acquisition aims to enable Codex to operate beyond single devices or sessions, allowing AI agents to continue complex tasks over extended periods within customer-controlled cloud infrastructure. Ona's technology, which has already supported millions of developers with secure cloud environments, will help OpenAI provide organizations with greater control over security, governance, and operational requirements while deploying AI agents. The integration is expected to facilitate the scaling of Codex across production workflows, ensuring that enterprises can confidently use AI agents in compliance with their security standards. The acquisition is subject to regulatory approval, and once completed, Ona's team will join OpenAI to further develop secure, persistent execution capabilities for Codex. This collaboration aims to support engineering teams in managing sustained software lifecycle tasks, such as testing, issue resolution, and application modernization, within trusted cloud environments.

items.title: BBVA scales ChatGPT Enterprise to 100,000 employees and partners with OpenAI to integrate AI across banking operations and customer experience globally [ ! ] [ ⬢ ]
items.content_text: BBVA has scaled ChatGPT Enterprise to approximately 100,000 employees worldwide as part of a strategic collaboration with OpenAI to integrate artificial intelligence across its banking operations, customer experience, and employee workflows. This partnership aims to transform banking by embedding AI into decision-making, risk analysis, and software development, enhancing efficiency and personalization. BBVA's AI transformation roadmap, known as "The Eight," guides the integration of AI to create a more proactive and intelligent banking experience, with leadership actively supporting the initiative to drive widespread usage and operational improvements.

items.title: Astrophysicist Chi-kwan Chan uses OpenAI Codex to develop and test algorithms simulating plasma behavior around black holes, aiding Event Horizon Telescope research [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: Astrophysicist Chi-kwan Chan uses OpenAI's Codex to develop and test new algorithms that simulate the behavior of plasma around black holes, enhancing the realism of models used by the Event Horizon Telescope (EHT) collaboration. These simulations help scientists study extreme physics near black holes and support efforts to produce the first video of a supermassive black hole. Chan's work addresses challenges in modeling plasma particles that spiral around magnetic fields near black holes, where traditional simulations require immense computing power due to the need to track tiny particle motions. By leveraging Codex to explore and validate novel mathematical approaches, Chan aims to overcome these limitations and improve the accuracy and efficiency of black hole simulations. This approach allows researchers to better interpret observational data and test fundamental theories like Einstein's general relativity. While AI-generated algorithms require rigorous testing, Chan emphasizes that scientific validation remains essential, and AI tools like Codex offer promising support for advancing astrophysical research.

items.title: OpenAI supports EU Code of Practice on AI content transparency, advancing provenance standards and tools for trustworthy AI ecosystem [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has announced its support for the European Union's Code of Practice on Transparency of AI-Generated Content, aiming to enhance provenance standards and tools that help users understand AI-created content. This initiative aligns with the EU AI Act and reflects OpenAI's ongoing commitment to building a trustworthy AI ecosystem through transparency and cooperation with industry stakeholders. OpenAI has been advancing provenance methods since 2024, incorporating C2PA metadata and SynthID watermarks in its AI-generated images, and providing public verification tools. The company collaborates with cross-industry groups to develop interoperable standards and employs a multi-layered approach combining metadata, watermarking, and product safeguards to ensure content authenticity and reduce misuse. The support for the Code of Practice underscores the importance of reliable provenance in combating disinformation and maintaining digital trust. OpenAI emphasizes that transparency efforts require ecosystem-wide collaboration to improve the robustness and interoperability of provenance techniques as AI-generated content becomes more prevalent.

items.title: OpenAI and Oracle partner to let Oracle Cloud customers use existing commitments to access OpenAI models and Codex starting in June 2026 [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI and Oracle have partnered to allow Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) customers to use their existing Oracle Universal Credits to access OpenAI's advanced models and Codex starting in June 2026. This integration enables enterprises to incorporate AI capabilities within their current procurement and governance frameworks, simplifying the adoption of AI technologies without requiring new purchasing processes. The collaboration aims to help organizations align AI deployment with their existing cloud investments and enterprise workflows, facilitating the development of AI applications that enhance automation, data analysis, and user experiences. Availability will begin in the coming weeks, with Oracle sales representatives providing further details and timing.

items.title: Google DeepMind releases DiffusionGemma, a 26B MoE model offering up to 4x faster text generation on GPUs with bi-directional attention and iterative self-correction [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: Google DeepMind has introduced DiffusionGemma, a 26 billion parameter Mixture of Experts (MoE) model designed for significantly faster text generation on GPUs. Unlike traditional autoregressive models that generate text token-by-token, DiffusionGemma produces entire blocks of text simultaneously, achieving up to four times faster inference speeds. This model features bi-directional attention and iterative self-correction, enabling it to refine outputs in real-time and handle complex tasks such as in-line editing and code infilling more effectively. DiffusionGemma operates efficiently on consumer-grade GPUs by activating only a subset of its parameters during inference, fitting within 18GB of VRAM when quantized. While it offers speed advantages for interactive and local workflows, its output quality is lower than that of standard Gemma 4 models, which remain recommended for high-quality production use. The model's diffusion-based approach shifts the computational bottleneck from memory bandwidth to processing power, making it particularly suited for low-latency applications where rapid text generation is critical.

items.title: OpenAI reports PRC-linked influence operations using AI-generated content to target US AI policy debates and data center narratives in 2026 [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has reported that influence operations linked to the People's Republic of China used AI-generated content to interfere in U.S. debates on artificial intelligence policy and technology infrastructure. These operations involved two main campaigns: one spreading claims that AI data center expansions were driving up electricity costs for families, and another criticizing U.S. tariffs while falsely alleging that ChatGPT user data had been compromised. The campaigns sought to covertly influence public opinion by exploiting existing concerns about energy prices and technology competition, while avoiding direct references to Chinese leadership. OpenAI banned the involved accounts and emphasized that these efforts aimed to manipulate democratic discussions and test narratives around critical AI infrastructure, though there was no evidence of significant impact beyond the operators' own activity. By disclosing these findings, OpenAI aims to assist governments, industry, and civil society in recognizing and countering foreign attempts to undermine democratic processes and promote authoritarian control through AI-based influence tactics.

items.title: Google DeepMind and partners announce $10M funding call for multi-agent AI safety research, inviting global proposals by August 2026 [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: Google DeepMind, along with partners Schmidt Sciences, the Cooperative AI Foundation, ARIA, and Google.org, has announced a $10 million funding call to support global research on multi-agent AI safety. This initiative aims to address the challenges posed by the interaction of millions of AI agents across digital environments, focusing on understanding and mitigating risks that arise when independent AI systems communicate and operate together. The funding targets research in four key areas: developing realistic test environments, studying the behavior of agent networks, enhancing secure agent infrastructure, and improving oversight and control mechanisms. Proposals are invited from academic and independent researchers worldwide, with applications open until August 2026 and awardees expected to be announced in autumn 2026. This effort seeks to build a safer and more stable AI ecosystem as multi-agent systems become increasingly prevalent.

items.title: LSEG deploys OpenAI tools to scale trusted AI across 4,000 employees, cutting product release cycles from six months to two weeks and accelerating customer delivery [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG) has integrated OpenAI's generative AI tools across its global operations, enabling around 4,000 employees to accelerate product development and customer delivery. This deployment has reduced product release cycles from approximately six months to two weeks and shortened the time from customer request to production deployment to about four weeks. LSEG's adoption of OpenAI technology supports faster insight generation, improved collaboration, and enhanced innovation within one of the world's most complex financial data ecosystems. LSEG's approach involved embedding governance and security measures while empowering teams to rethink workflows and leverage AI for tasks such as report drafting, market data synthesis, and rapid prototyping. The initiative has led to increased analyst productivity and a cultural shift toward faster, more creative problem-solving. By aligning with customer demand and integrating AI into existing workflows, LSEG has positioned itself to deliver trusted AI solutions at scale, transforming how financial data is utilized internally and by clients.

items.title: Google launches Gemini 3.5 Live Translate for near real-time speech translation in over 70 languages across Google AI Studio, Translate, and Meet [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: Google has introduced Gemini 3.5 Live Translate, a new audio model that enables near real-time speech-to-speech translation in over 70 languages. This technology is integrated into Google AI Studio, Google Translate, and Google Meet, offering smooth, natural-sounding translations that maintain the speaker's intonation and pacing without awkward pauses. The model continuously generates speech during conversations, staying just seconds behind the speaker to provide fluid audio. It supports multilingual inputs without manual configuration and is designed to work well in noisy environments. Gemini 3.5 Live Translate is available to developers via the Gemini Live API, in private preview for Google Meet enterprise users, and broadly through the Google Translate app on Android and iOS, enhancing live interpretation for calls, meetings, and broadcasts.

items.title: Google DeepMind introduces Gemma 4 12B, a unified encoder-free multimodal model with native audio input and laptop-ready efficiency [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: Google DeepMind has introduced Gemma 4 12B, a new unified, encoder-free multimodal model designed to deliver advanced multimodal intelligence directly on laptops. This model supports native audio input and offers high-performance reasoning capabilities comparable to larger models, while maintaining a compact size that runs efficiently on devices with just 16GB of VRAM or unified memory. Released under an Apache 2.0 license, Gemma 4 12B aims to make powerful multimodal AI accessible and practical for a wide range of applications. Gemma 4 12B features a novel architecture that eliminates separate multimodal encoders by integrating vision and audio inputs directly into the language model backbone. This approach reduces latency and memory usage, enabling faster and more efficient processing. The model replaces traditional vision encoders with a lightweight embedding module and projects raw audio signals into the same space as text tokens, streamlining multimodal input handling. Developers can access Gemma 4 12B through various platforms and tools, including LM Studio, Ollama, and Google AI Edge apps, with pre-trained weights available on Hugging Face and Kaggle. The release also includes a Skills Repository to support agentic development and integration options for deployment on Google Cloud, facilitating versatile use cases from local inference to enterprise applications.

items.title: Google DeepMind launches three-month accelerator for 15 European robotics startups, providing AI mentorship and access to advanced models to scale real-world applications [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: Google DeepMind has launched a three-month accelerator program to support 15 early-stage robotics startups across Europe. The program offers intensive mentorship, technical support, and access to advanced AI models to help these companies integrate artificial intelligence into their products and scale real-world applications. The selected startups work in diverse fields including healthcare, manufacturing, climate solutions, and logistics. Participants in the accelerator receive hands-on guidance from Google DeepMind and Google experts, leveraging Google's AI stack and robotics models to transform cutting-edge research into practical robotic technologies. This initiative aims to advance the development of physical AI, enabling intelligent machines to interact more effectively and safely with the real world, addressing significant challenges through innovative robotics solutions.

items.title: Nextdoor engineers use Codex with GPT-5.5 to accelerate cross-platform development and debug complex issues, enabling faster product delivery for over 110 million users [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: Engineers at Nextdoor leverage Codex integrated with GPT-5.5 to enhance cross-platform development and efficiently debug complex issues, enabling faster product delivery for over 110 million users across 11 countries. This approach allows engineers to focus more on product outcomes rather than technical details, accelerating development and empowering individual engineers to own end-to-end product experiences. By using Codex, Nextdoor's engineering team has significantly reduced the time spent on debugging and building features, such as the recent Opportunity Alerts, which connect users with local service providers. The technology supports tackling challenging technical problems, including embedded systems and Kubernetes issues, with improved persistence and precision, shifting organizational bottlenecks from engineering capacity to strategic decision-making about product direction.

items.title: Notion uses OpenAI Codex to reduce development time from two weeks to hours, enabling AI voice input on the web and boosting engineering productivity across small teams [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: Notion has significantly accelerated its development process by using OpenAI's Codex, reducing the time to build features from two weeks to just a few hours. This technology enabled the company to implement AI voice input on its web platform by analyzing existing mobile code and generating a web-compatible version that met their coding standards, allowing for rapid deployment and user testing. The integration of Codex has transformed how Notion's engineering team operates, allowing engineers and managers alike to delegate coding tasks to the AI and focus on higher-level work. This shift has increased productivity, enabling small teams or even individuals to handle multiple projects simultaneously and deliver features more efficiently while maintaining team support and collaboration.

items.title: OpenAI proposes people-first industrial policy ideas for the AI era to expand opportunity, share prosperity, and build resilient institutions [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has introduced a set of people-first industrial policy proposals aimed at guiding the development of advanced artificial intelligence. These ideas focus on expanding opportunities, sharing prosperity, and building resilient institutions to ensure that the benefits of AI are widely distributed as the technology evolves toward superintelligence. The proposals are intended as an initial framework to stimulate discussion and are open to refinement through public feedback and democratic processes. To support this effort, OpenAI is organizing a pilot program offering fellowships and research grants, as well as hosting discussions at its new workshop in Washington, DC, to further explore and develop these policy ideas.

items.title: OpenAI confirms confidential draft S-1 submission to SEC with no set timeline for public offering [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has confirmed that it submitted a confidential draft S-1 registration statement to the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC), signaling a potential step toward going public. However, the company has not set a timeline for a public offering and indicated that it may remain private for some time to pursue certain initiatives more easily. The confidential filing provides OpenAI with the flexibility to proceed with an initial public offering if it becomes the best course of action. The announcement was made proactively in anticipation of possible leaks and does not constitute an offer to sell securities.

items.title: Google DeepMind reports AI-powered Gemini Guided Learning boosted math scores by up to 2.5 years in eight-week Sierra Leone trial involving 1,763 students [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: Google DeepMind conducted a randomized controlled trial in Sierra Leone involving 1,763 junior secondary students to evaluate the impact of its AI-powered Gemini Guided Learning feature on math progress. Over eight weeks, students using Guided Learning showed significant improvements, with math scores increasing by up to 2.5 years of typical learning progress compared to a control group. The trial demonstrated high student engagement and a shift toward deeper conceptual understanding rather than simply seeking answers. The study emphasized the role of teachers in facilitating AI-supported learning, with educators designing lessons and guiding classroom discussions. Teachers also reported professional growth through the use of Gemini, which helped them explain concepts more effectively. The trial's results suggest that AI can augment teaching by promoting critical thinking and active learning, rather than replacing educators. DeepMind plans to conduct further trials globally to build a comprehensive evidence base on AI's impact in education. They are also releasing resources to help others implement similar AI-driven learning programs and are committed to advancing responsible AI development in education through ongoing research and collaboration.

items.title: OpenAI outlines plan to develop safe, accessible AGI aimed at broad societal benefit and shared prosperity [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has outlined its plan to develop artificial general intelligence (AGI) with a focus on safety, accessibility, and broad societal benefit. The company emphasizes that AGI should empower people, distribute benefits widely, and remain aligned with human values and control to ensure it serves humanity as a whole. The plan draws parallels to the transformative impact of electricity, highlighting AI's potential to enhance daily life and expand human capabilities across various fields. OpenAI stresses the importance of public coordination and international cooperation to manage risks and guide the development of AI technologies responsibly, aiming to prevent concentration of power and promote shared prosperity.

items.title: OpenAI launches Economic Research Exchange to fund external studies on AI's impact on jobs, productivity, and the economy with applications open through July 2026 [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has launched the Economic Research Exchange, a new initiative to fund and support external research projects examining the economic impacts of artificial intelligence. The program invites researchers to propose studies that use OpenAI tools and datasets to generate rigorous, privacy-protected empirical evidence on how AI affects jobs, productivity, firms, and the broader economy. Applications for selected research collaborations are open until July 5, 2026, with notifications expected by the end of that month. The Exchange aims to foster high-quality research through structured projects with clear milestones and data governance, focusing on areas such as labor economics, productivity, inequality, and public finance. This effort complements OpenAI's broader work to improve measurement of AI's economic effects and seeks to provide valuable insights for policymakers, businesses, and the public during a period of rapid technological change.

items.title: Endava integrates OpenAI's ChatGPT Enterprise and Codex to redesign software delivery with AI agents, accelerating workflows and expanding AI adoption across its 11,000-person global workforce [ * ] [ ⬢ ]
items.content_text: Endava, a global technology services company, is transforming its software delivery by integrating OpenAI's ChatGPT Enterprise and Codex to embed AI agents into daily workflows. This approach accelerates software development, automates various business processes, and fosters an AI-native culture across its 11,000 employees worldwide. The company developed DavaFlow, an AI-driven delivery methodology that incorporates OpenAI technology throughout the software lifecycle, from planning to deployment. Beyond engineering, AI adoption has expanded to legal, finance, and operations teams, streamlining tasks such as research, reporting, and project coordination. Endava emphasizes behavior change, leadership involvement, and experimentation as key factors in successful AI integration. Looking ahead, Endava plans to advance enterprise AI by orchestrating models, agents, and workflows to reshape organizational operations. The company encourages others to embrace AI personally to stay relevant in the evolving technological landscape.

items.title: OpenAI rolls out Dreaming V3 memory system for ChatGPT Plus and Pro users in the US, improving context retention, preference tracking, and relevance across conversations [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has launched Dreaming V3, an advanced memory system for ChatGPT Plus and Pro users in the US, designed to enhance the model's ability to retain context, track user preferences, and maintain relevance across conversations. This new system builds on previous memory features by synthesizing information from multiple interactions to provide fresher and more accurate responses without relying solely on explicit memory commands. Dreaming V3 improves upon earlier versions by automatically curating and updating memories in the background, allowing ChatGPT to better understand ongoing user needs and preferences over time. Users can review and manage their stored memories through a summary page, enabling more personalized and context-aware interactions. The update aims to make ChatGPT more helpful by remembering useful details and adapting to changes, with plans to expand availability to more users and regions in the coming weeks.

items.title: OpenAI launches biodefense action plan leveraging GPT-Rosalind AI model to enhance biological threat detection and pandemic preparedness in 2026 [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has launched a biodefense action plan centered around its advanced AI model, GPT-Rosalind, to enhance biological threat detection and pandemic preparedness. Introduced in April 2026, GPT-Rosalind supports research in biology, drug discovery, and medicine, aiming to improve health outcomes by accelerating scientific understanding and therapy development. Recognizing the dual-use nature of these AI capabilities, OpenAI announced Rosalind Biodefense in May 2026 to empower trusted developers in building biodefense tools while emphasizing responsible use and governance. The action plan seeks to create a more resilient biological future by enabling earlier threat detection, faster countermeasure development, and more coordinated crisis responses.

items.title: OpenAI updates GPT-Rosalind with enhanced biological reasoning, medicinal chemistry, genomics analysis, and experimental workflow capabilities for life sciences research [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has released an updated version of GPT-Rosalind, a model designed specifically for life sciences research. The new update integrates GPT-5.5's advanced coding and tool-use abilities with enhanced expertise in medicinal chemistry, genomics, and broader biological analysis, improving performance across drug discovery and experimental workflows. The update was evaluated using LifeSciBench, a benchmark developed to assess models on comprehensive life sciences tasks including evidence handling, scientific reasoning, and experimental validation. GPT-Rosalind demonstrated significant gains in addressing complex research challenges, such as analyzing clinical trial data and supporting drug development decisions, and is now available for research preview to qualified organizations worldwide.

items.title: Wasmer used OpenAI Codex with GPT-5.5 to build a Node.js runtime for the edge, accelerating development from one year to two weeks [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: Wasmer used OpenAI's Codex with GPT-5.5 to develop a Node.js runtime for edge computing, reducing the development time from one year to just two weeks. This breakthrough enables running Node.js workloads inside a WebAssembly sandbox without Docker, making Wasmer the first cloud host to offer full Node.js support at the edge. The small Wasmer team leveraged Codex's advanced reasoning and debugging capabilities throughout the project, which allowed them to tackle complex challenges and accelerate development by 10 to 20 times. This achievement opens new possibilities for ambitious projects in edge computing that were previously impractical for smaller companies.

items.title: OpenAI proposes a federal blueprint for U.S. governance of frontier AI focusing on safety, resilience, and national security [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has released a blueprint proposing a federal framework for the governance of frontier AI in the United States, emphasizing safety, resilience, and national security. The plan suggests building on existing state laws and strengthening the role of the Center for AI Safety and Innovation (CAISI) as the primary federal institution overseeing AI safety. It also calls for a coordinated government-wide approach to address the challenges posed by advanced AI technologies. The blueprint comes at a time when several states, including California, New York, and Illinois, have enacted frontier AI safety laws, and the White House has issued an executive order promoting AI innovation and security. OpenAI's proposal aims to create durable institutions capable of evolving alongside AI advancements to ensure responsible development and deployment.

items.title: OpenAI outlines public policy agenda focusing on AI safety, youth protection, workforce transition, and global standards to ensure AI benefits society [ * ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has released its public policy agenda focused on ensuring that artificial general intelligence (AGI) benefits all of humanity. The agenda emphasizes AI safety, protecting youth, supporting workforce transitions, and establishing global standards to promote equitable access and responsible development of AI technologies. OpenAI aims to collaborate with governments and civil society to address risks, expand opportunities, and foster democratic participation in shaping AI's future. The policy priorities include advancing frontier AI safety through transparency, accountability, and regulatory frameworks at both state and federal levels in the US, as well as promoting international cooperation on AI standards. OpenAI supports measures to mitigate risks related to advanced AI models, including national security concerns, while advocating for inclusive access to AI tools across diverse demographics. The agenda reflects OpenAI's commitment to adapting policies as AI evolves to ensure broad societal benefits.

items.title: Travelers deploys OpenAI-powered AI Claim Assistant nationwide to provide 24/7 customer support and scale claims processing during peak demand [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: Travelers has launched an AI-powered Claim Assistant nationwide, developed with OpenAI's Realtime API and advanced models, to provide customers with 24/7 support for filing auto property damage claims. The assistant guides users through the claims process using natural conversation, answers policy questions, and submits claims autonomously, helping Travelers manage high volumes during peak demand and catastrophe events. Initially deployed in eight states, the AI Claim Assistant was expanded across the country within two months, with 85-90% of customers completing their claims through the system. This solution enables immediate customer assistance without wait times while allowing claim professionals to focus on more complex cases, enhancing operational efficiency and customer experience at scale.

items.title: OpenAI launches new Codex plugins and interactive sites tailored for analysts, marketers, designers, investors, and other teams to enhance AI-driven workflows [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has introduced new role-specific Codex plugins, interactive sites, and annotations designed to enhance AI-driven workflows for various teams including analysts, marketers, designers, investors, and others. These tools integrate with popular apps and workflows to help users generate reports, create marketing assets, manage sales processes, design products, and analyze investments more efficiently without requiring coding skills. The new plugins cover a range of functions such as data analytics, creative production, sales, product design, public equity investing, and investment banking, with plans to expand into additional areas like corporate finance and legal. Additionally, Codex now supports creating and sharing interactive websites and apps within workspaces, enabling teams to collaborate and track progress through shared URLs. This development aims to make Codex more adaptable to diverse professional roles and workflows, fostering greater productivity across different industries.

items.title: OpenAI calls for global AI Safety Institute to enhance youth protections and opportunities ahead of G7 Leaders' Summit in June 2026 [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has proposed the creation of a global AI Safety Institute aimed at enhancing protections and opportunities for young people as artificial intelligence becomes increasingly integrated into education and daily life. This initiative, highlighted ahead of the G7 Leaders' Summit in June 2026, seeks to establish international collaboration to develop consistent safety standards, share research, and provide practical guidance for youth AI use. The proposed institute would build on existing efforts like Common Sense Media's Youth AI Safety Institute and partnerships with educators and researchers, including projects in Estonia and the United States. OpenAI emphasizes the importance of age-appropriate safeguards, regular risk assessments, parental controls, and transparent communication about AI's benefits and risks to ensure safe and supportive AI experiences for young users. OpenAI plans to work with governments, civil society, academia, and industry partners to promote sustained global leadership on youth AI safety, aiming to maintain momentum beyond the G7 summit and adapt to the evolving technological landscape.

items.title: OpenAI says Codex now serves over 5 million weekly users, expanding from developers to knowledge workers automating research, data analysis, and workflow tasks [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI's Codex has expanded beyond its original developer base to serve over 5 million weekly users, including a rapidly growing segment of knowledge workers. These users leverage Codex for automating tasks such as research, data analysis, workflow automation, and content creation, enhancing productivity across various professions. The Next Era of Knowledge Work report highlights that knowledge workers now make up about 20 percent of Codex users and are adopting the tool at a faster rate than developers. By enabling users to handle multiple tasks simultaneously and reduce friction in modern workflows, Codex is reshaping how work is conducted and potentially accelerating career growth.

items.title: OpenAI outlines its AI policy stance, supports transparent advocacy and thoughtful regulation, and clarifies no outside political group represents the company [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has outlined its stance on AI policy and political advocacy, emphasizing transparency, support for thoughtful regulation, and AI safety. The company clarified that it does not have any employee-funded Political Action Committees (PACs), has not made donations to super PACs or political campaigns, and that no outside political group represents its views. OpenAI stresses that its policy positions should be judged by its public statements and actions, not by the personal political activities of its employees or affiliated individuals. The company highlighted the importance of broad participation in shaping AI governance, involving governments, researchers, workers, civil society, and the public rather than any single organization. OpenAI also addressed questions about the organization Leading the Future (LTF), noting that any involvement by its president and co-founder, Greg Brockman, and his wife is strictly personal and not on behalf of the company. OpenAI advocates for clear, honest AI policy advocacy free from misleading tactics and commits to continuing its efforts transparently and directly.

items.title: OpenAI breaks ground on 1GW data center in Michigan with community partnerships, creating over 2,500 union construction jobs and investing $10 million in local projects [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has begun construction on The Barn, a 1GW data center campus in Saline, Michigan, as part of its Stargate project to build AI infrastructure. The initiative aims to expand AI access, create over 2,500 union construction jobs, and invest $10 million in local community projects, including improvements to the Saline Recreation Center. The project also promises to protect local resources and prevent increased costs for local residents. The data center will use a closed-loop cooling system to minimize water use and will not pass infrastructure costs onto local ratepayers. OpenAI is partnering with local organizations and government officials, including Governor Gretchen Whitmer, to ensure the project supports Michigan's workforce through union jobs and apprenticeship programs. Additionally, OpenAI plans to provide up to $45 million in Codex credits to eligible Michigan students to enhance AI literacy and workforce training. This development is part of a broader effort to foster economic growth and technological leadership in Michigan, supporting local schools and services through projected tax revenues of $1 billion over the lease term. The project reflects a commitment to building AI infrastructure responsibly while investing in the communities that host it.

items.title: OpenAI frontier models and Codex become generally available on AWS, enabling enterprises to build AI with existing AWS security and governance workflows [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI's frontier models and Codex are now generally available on AWS, enabling enterprises to integrate advanced AI capabilities within their existing AWS security, governance, and procurement frameworks. This integration allows organizations to accelerate AI adoption by using familiar AWS environments to move from evaluation to production more efficiently. The availability includes OpenAI models and Codex on Amazon Bedrock, which supports AI application development with AWS-native controls. Customers such as Amgen and Autodesk highlight the benefits of deploying these models on AWS for enhancing scientific research and design workflows while maintaining high standards for security and operational governance. Looking ahead, OpenAI and AWS plan to expand these offerings, including the introduction of Daybreak, a suite of cyber security tools designed to improve software resilience through AI-driven code review and threat analysis. This partnership aims to help more organizations deploy advanced AI solutions securely and effectively within their existing infrastructure.

items.title: Boston Children's Hospital uses OpenAI-powered AI to diagnose over 40 rare diseases and save 60,000 operational hours, redeploying $7 million in labor [ ! ] [ ⬢ ]
items.content_text: Boston Children's Hospital has integrated OpenAI-powered artificial intelligence into its clinical and operational workflows to enhance patient care, reduce costs, and improve efficiency. This implementation has enabled the hospital to diagnose over 40 rare diseases that were previously unresolved, save approximately 60,000 operational hours, and redeploy more than $7 million in labor through over 50 AI-driven automations. The hospital developed an enterprise AI layer, a secure internal ChatGPT environment, to support various teams including clinical, research, and administrative staff. This system helps synthesize complex medical data, streamline scheduling, and automate routine tasks, allowing staff to focus on higher-value work. The AI tools have been embedded across the organization to meet specific needs, resulting in faster innovation cycles and broader adoption among employees. By leveraging AI for both operational improvements and clinical discovery, Boston Children's has significantly advanced its capacity to diagnose rare diseases and optimize resource allocation. The approach demonstrates how AI can be effectively integrated into healthcare infrastructure to address cognitive limits and operational challenges while improving patient outcomes.

items.title: Braintrust engineers use Codex with GPT-5.5 to convert customer feature requests into preview code branches within minutes, accelerating development and feedback loops [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: Braintrust engineers leverage Codex with GPT-5.5 to rapidly convert customer feature requests into preview code branches, enabling faster development and real-time feedback. This approach has allowed half of the Braintrust team to adopt Codex within a month, significantly accelerating their workflow and enhancing customer collaboration. The speed of Codex enables the team to integrate iteration directly into their development process, moving feature requests from backlog to live previews in minutes. This capability supports autonomous problem-solving by allowing engineers to define problems, create test environments, and let Codex generate solutions efficiently, fostering more experimentation and quicker delivery of quality AI products.

items.title: OpenAI launches Rosalind Biodefense to provide vetted developers and U.S. government partners with trusted access to GPT-Rosalind for biodefense and pandemic preparedness [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has launched Rosalind Biodefense, a new initiative designed to provide vetted developers and U.S. government partners with trusted access to GPT-Rosalind, its advanced AI model for life sciences research. This program aims to support the development of biodefense and pandemic preparedness tools by enabling the creation of applications that enhance public health and biological threat response capabilities. The initiative builds on OpenAI's ongoing efforts to ensure the safe and responsible deployment of powerful AI in biology, including collaborations with government agencies and expert organizations. Rosalind Biodefense will sponsor access to GPT-Rosalind and assist trusted developers in building tools for epidemiological modeling, early detection, screening, and other public health measures, thereby strengthening societal resilience against future biological threats.

items.title: OpenAI shares guidance on designing trustworthy third-party AI evaluations for frontier model capabilities and safeguards [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has published guidance on designing trustworthy third-party evaluations for frontier AI models, focusing on assessing capabilities, safeguards, and the validity of results. The guidance emphasizes the importance of clearly defining the claims being tested and providing evidence to support the evaluation's validity, especially as models now operate within complex environments using tools and multi-step workflows. The guidance outlines different types of claims-capability elicitation, safeguard performance, and model comparison-and stresses the role of the evaluation setup, or "harness," in influencing performance outcomes. It also highlights common validity concerns such as reward hacking, refusals, contamination, broken problems, and sandbagging, recommending transparency about these factors to improve the reliability and usefulness of evaluation reports.

items.title: Endava uses Codex to codify senior engineering expertise and accelerate software delivery, reducing requirements analysis from weeks to hours across global teams [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: Endava, a global software contracting firm, leverages Codex to codify senior engineering expertise and accelerate its software delivery process, significantly reducing requirements analysis from weeks to hours. By integrating Codex across the entire delivery lifecycle, Endava has transformed into an agentic organization where senior knowledge guides teams in real time, enhancing collaboration and output quality. Codex enables junior developers to produce senior-level work by providing architectural guidance and best practices, effectively scaling mentorship and expertise across global teams. This approach compresses traditionally sequential stages like analysis, design, and build into a unified process, improving efficiency and client engagement through live documentation and rapid iteration. Endava's experience highlights the value of embedding senior judgment into AI tools to amplify team capabilities and streamline workflows beyond coding, including requirements analysis and client communication. Their success suggests that adopting such AI-driven methods can unlock substantial productivity gains in software development.

items.title: OpenAI publishes Frontier Governance Framework detailing AI safety and security practices aligned with emerging EU and California regulations [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has released its Frontier Governance Framework, outlining how its AI safety and security practices comply with emerging legal standards such as California's Transparency in Frontier AI Act and the EU AI Act's Code of Practice for General Purpose AI. The framework builds on OpenAI's Preparedness Framework, detailing risk assessment and mitigation strategies for advanced AI systems, including areas like cybersecurity, harmful manipulation, and loss of control. The document also addresses model reporting, security risk management, incident response, and the incorporation of external expert input. OpenAI plans to update the framework as AI capabilities and regulatory requirements evolve, ensuring ongoing alignment with legal obligations and safety best practices.

items.title: MUFG deploys ChatGPT Enterprise to 35,000 employees with OpenAI to build AI-native workflows and launch new AI-powered financial services [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: MUFG has deployed ChatGPT Enterprise to around 35,000 employees at Mitsubishi UFJ Bank as part of its effort to become an AI-native organization. In partnership with OpenAI, MUFG is integrating AI into daily workflows to enhance operational efficiency and develop new AI-powered financial services for customers. The rollout began in 2026 following a collaboration that started in 2024, focusing on secure and broad adoption across the bank. MUFG combined leadership commitment with employee training and support from OpenAI to ensure confident and compliant use of AI tools, fostering a culture where AI is a natural part of work rather than a specialized resource. This initiative aims to transform MUFG's financial operations and customer experiences by embedding AI deeply into its services and organizational processes, positioning the bank for future innovation in the financial sector.

items.title: Cisco integrates OpenAI Codex into enterprise engineering workflows, accelerating AI-native development and defect remediation with 10-15x throughput gains [ ! ] [ ⬢ ]
items.content_text: Cisco has integrated OpenAI's Codex into its enterprise engineering workflows, significantly enhancing AI-native development and defect remediation. This collaboration has enabled Cisco to accelerate the development of AI Defense features and automate complex engineering tasks, achieving a 10-15 times increase in defect resolution throughput and saving over 1,500 engineering hours per month. By embedding Codex directly into production workflows, Cisco has leveraged its capabilities to understand large codebases, execute autonomous compile-test-fix loops, and operate within strict security and governance frameworks. This integration has led to improvements such as a 20% reduction in build times and rapid framework migrations, demonstrating Codex's role as an AI engineering teammate at enterprise scale. Cisco's ongoing partnership with OpenAI has also influenced Codex's development roadmap, focusing on compliance, long-running task management, and seamless integration with existing pipelines. This collaboration underscores Cisco's commitment to advancing AI security and operational efficiency in complex software environments.

items.title: OpenAI and Thrive build self-improving Tax AI using Codex to automate and accelerate tax return preparation for Crete accounting firms [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI and Thrive Holdings collaborated to develop a self-improving Tax AI using Codex, designed to automate and accelerate tax return preparation for over 30 accounting firms in Crete. The system processes complex tax filings, significantly reducing manual data entry time and improving accuracy, with the AI continuously enhancing its performance through structured feedback from real-world use. During a pilot involving 7,000 tax returns, Tax AI saved practitioners about a third of their preparation time and achieved up to 97% accuracy in drafting returns. The AI's ability to self-improve was demonstrated by a rapid increase in the percentage of returns completed with high accuracy, enabling it to handle increasingly complex tax documents and workflows as the tax season progressed. The development leveraged expert practitioner input, detailed production data, and a Codex-driven iteration loop to identify and address errors autonomously. This approach not only improved efficiency but also allowed for faster product development and adaptation to complex tax scenarios, offering a model for integrating AI with domain expertise in professional services.

items.title: OpenAI outlines 2026 election safeguards including reliable voting information, cyber defense support, and AI content transparency measures [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has outlined a series of safeguards for the 2026 global elections aimed at ensuring reliable voting information, supporting cyber defense efforts, and enhancing transparency around AI-generated content. Building on initiatives from 2024, OpenAI plans to provide live vote counts in the US and Brazil, partner with organizations to share accurate voting logistics, and improve web search results with source links to help users access trustworthy election information. The company is also advancing cybersecurity through its Daybreak program, which includes tools like Codex Security to identify software vulnerabilities and Trusted Access for Cyber to support election system defenders. Additionally, OpenAI is implementing digital watermarking and metadata standards to help verify AI-generated images and combat misinformation, while collaborating with social media platforms and supporting legislation to promote transparency in election-related content.

items.title: Warp uses GPT-5.5 and OpenAI models to coordinate coding agents across local, cloud, and open-source development workflows, enabling 90% of internal pull requests to be agent-created [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: Warp leverages GPT-5.5 and OpenAI models to coordinate coding agents across local, cloud, and open-source development workflows, enabling agents to create about 90% of the company's internal pull requests. This approach, called Open Agentic Development, allows human developers to define objectives and supervise outcomes while agents handle planning, coding, testing, and submitting changes. Warp's orchestration platform, Oz, manages these agents by deploying and coordinating them across environments, supporting long-running workflows with features like persistent memory and context management. The use of GPT-5.5 improves efficiency by reducing token usage per task and enhances the agents' ability to reason across complex coding problems, helping Warp scale its agent-driven development processes effectively.

items.title: OpenAI model disproves 80-year-old planar unit distance conjecture in discrete geometry, marking first AI-solved major math problem [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: An OpenAI model has disproved the 80-year-old planar unit distance conjecture, a central problem in discrete geometry originally posed by Paul Erdős. This breakthrough provides an infinite family of examples that improve on the previously believed optimal constructions, marking the first time an AI has autonomously solved a major open problem in mathematics. The proof, verified by external mathematicians, introduces sophisticated algebraic number theory techniques to address this longstanding question. The model's success came from a general-purpose reasoning system rather than one specifically trained for mathematics or this problem, highlighting the advanced reasoning capabilities of current AI. Leading mathematicians have praised the result as a milestone in AI-driven mathematics, noting the model's originality and depth of insight. This achievement demonstrates AI's potential to contribute original ideas and complete complex proofs in frontier mathematical research.

The lab will focus on advancing AI applications in public service, finance, healthcare, and digital infrastructure, while also collaborating with local partners to build AI skills through educational programs and workforce development initiatives. items.title: OpenAI advances AI content provenance with C2PA conformance, Google SynthID watermarking, and a public verification tool for AI-generated images [ * ] [ ◼ ]

These measures aim to help users verify the origin and authenticity of AI-generated images, improving transparency and trust in digital media. The company has been embedding Content Credentials in images generated by its tools since 2024 and recently became a C2PA Conforming Generator Product, ensuring that provenance metadata can be preserved and recognized across platforms. To complement metadata, OpenAI partnered with Google DeepMind to add invisible SynthID watermarks that remain detectable even after common image transformations, enhancing the durability of provenance signals. OpenAI's new public verification tool allows users to check whether images were created using OpenAI's models by detecting embedded provenance signals. This multi-layered strategy addresses challenges in content verification and supports a more trustworthy information ecosystem by making AI-generated content easier to identify and authenticate.

items.title: Google expands content transparency tools with SynthID watermarking and C2PA credentials across Search, Gemini, Chrome, Pixel, and Cloud to verify AI-generated and edited media [ * ] [ ◼ ]

OpenAI's tailored sandbox ensures Codex can function securely on Windows laptops, matching the safety and usability standards available on other operating systems.

items.title: OpenAI details response to TanStack Mini Shai-Hulud npm supply chain attack, rotates macOS app signing certificates, and requires updates by June 26, 2026
items.content_text: OpenAI has responded to the TanStack "Mini Shai-Hulud" npm supply chain attack by securing its systems and rotating macOS app signing certificates. The company found no evidence of compromised user data or altered software but identified limited credential exposure in internal repositories. To enhance security, OpenAI requires macOS users to update their applications by June 26, 2026, to prevent risks associated with the compromised certificates. The attack affected two employee devices and involved unauthorized access to some internal source code repositories. OpenAI took immediate action by isolating impacted systems, revoking credentials, and coordinating with platform providers to block unauthorized use of certificates. The company also accelerated deployment of security controls to mitigate supply chain threats and confirmed no unauthorized modifications to its published software. OpenAI's measures include blocking new notarizations with the previous certificates and ensuring that apps signed with old certificates will be blocked by macOS security protections after the update deadline. Users can update safely through in-app updates or official links, and no action is required for Windows and iOS apps. The company remains committed to transparency and ongoing protection against evolving software supply chain risks.
